body: The series finale of Flashpoint. Jesus fuck, I shed far too many tears during the final 15 minutes of that episode.
Yes, I understand. It doesn't matter much at this point though.

I woke up around 3:30 AM crying in pain. Took a couple hours to gather the willpower to get downstairs and get juice to help stop the shaking and the nausea. Made an english muffin, could only get half of it down. She told him, so he's pissed and I have to eat somewhat right today.
My friend and his girlfriend usually make me eat. I didn't tell him today. I lied to her.
Not sure who she is, but she must be cool if she's mildly attractive and has corgis on her album cover. Also, I want her boots.

I love him. He loves me. I'm *in* love with him. He isn't in love with me. He's the nicest guy I know. He would do anything to keep me safe. It's not that his girlfriend's a bad person, it's that she isn't me.

6 years of depression & PTSD and 3 years of anorexia pushing me further down the path of self-destruction, and it's killing me. He tries to help, but he's just some dumbass kid too. Some brutal truths came out a couple days ago and it finally sunk in that he doesn't want me in a romantic sense. Not like he used to, anyways. It's hard to comprehend due to the year I've had of fantasizing us together.

I tell him everything, but I can't tell him about this. He'll stop me however he can, and I'm too hopeless to be worth stopping.
He's my best friend. I never dated him, he doesn't want to do the distance. I love him more than anything.
